installedPlugin.sourceContext: Installed plugin owns native recording; no fake Undo service or added project capabilities.
installedPlugin.interactionLimit: Computer-assisted input; user enlarged the restored floating panel. Not an unassisted usability study.

defectsFoundAndFixed: Engine fixture initially passed ReadVoxelChannels.Size to WriteVoxelChannels. Writes now project only valid channels; both initially empty boxes were restored and verified before rerunning.
Native Parts clamp to 2048 studs. R1B limits now prevent silent geometry clamping; maximum tile exercised.
SelectionChanged erased successful operation messages. A separate selection label preserves status.
Destroy prevented native Undo from restoring removed hierarchy. Removal now detaches the original owned instance; installed guide/archive Undo and Redo passed.
Yielding between source rechecks could miss an edit to an earlier chunk. Save yields before its bounded serial recheck; regression test added.
limits: R1B orientation is a provisional sketch, not site-specific Sky City authoring.
Production archive capture does not write or restore Terrain.
No multiplayer lifecycle, Actors, RemoteFunction, anti-scraping guarantee, comparative runtime benchmark or public release.
Syntax compilation and strict annotations do not establish full Roblox type analysis.
